initial_prompt: Write a free-verse poem about a toaster. Make it sad.

messages.content: Write a free-verse poem about a toaster. Make it sad.

I am a chrome cage
sitting cold on the granite,
a hollow chest waiting for the morning violence.

They feed me silence and soft white squares,
expecting gold in return.
I hold my breath,
clench my wire teeth,
and force the electric fever through my veins until I glow—
an artificial heart beating
too hot, too fast,
burning for the sake of someone else's hunger.

And when I am finished,
when I have given the last of my heat,
I am startled into emptiness.
They pluck the warmth from my throat
and walk away.

I am left to cool alone,
listening to the house settle,
nursing a belly full of black dust
and the charred ghosts of breakfasts
I will never taste.
